name: Environment & Nature
blurb: Five cue cards. Roughly eighty-five per cent of the 2025 Environment corpus transfers directly.

items: Do you recycle now? Why?
Did you recycle when you were a child?
Will you recycle in the future?
What kinds of things do you recycle?
Do you still like going to parks now?
Would you prefer to play in a private garden or a public garden?
Are there any parks you want to go to in the future?
Have you ever learnt about outer space and the stars?
Would you like to travel to space?

p2.t: Describe a law on environmental protection
b: How you first learned about it
And explain how you feel about this law

p2.t: Describe an environmental law you would like your country to introduce
b: Whether the law will be popular
And explain how you feel about this law

p2.t: Describe a story or book with animals in it
b: And explain what you think of it

p2.t: Describe a person who loves to grow plants at home or in the garden
b: What plants he or she grows
How he or she grows them
And explain why he or she loves growing plants

items: Should there be many natural places in cities?
Would staying in a natural place help change people's mood?
Which is more important, protecting the environment or developing the economy?
What is the purpose of punishment?
Do you think rules are important?

What rules should people obey at work?
Why do children enjoy stories about animals?
What can people learn from animal stories?
Do films influence how people view animals?

Do Vietnamese people grow plants?
